name: Chamomile
note: Roman chamomile, Chamaemelum nobile (docs/future/13 section 5, P2b). A tea herb: the walker gathers its flowers through summer (recipes/world/gather.json chamomile.flowers). Drawn with the thrift shader (draw: thrift; flora-thrift.wgsl), so its keys are the thrift's: a low, feathery mat of fine leaves carrying small white daisies (round heads for now; P2b B2 gives them a flat white head with a gold heart). drawScale: the shape is drawn this many times real size, so an ankle-high mat can be found (Matt, October 24, 2026: 1.5 from the start); a real mat is about 12 cm across with flowers 2 cm wide, and the shape numbers below already include the factor. habitat (docs/future/13 5.3): sandy turf above the strandline, 0.8 to 4 m above the sea, dry, a little salt at most, never in the tide band. growth: the herb defaults of 5.4, drowning under 3 cm of water for 48 hours. It flowers from early summer into early autumn and rests as a low crown in winter (dormant). spread kind rhizome as in watermint.json, but creeping only in late summer (spread.window), up to maxCount on the island. volunteer.seasons: summer only. starter: test links only. plantTool false: gather plants are not offered by the Plant tool.

phenology.note: each plant keeps its own calendar, offset from the species by up to jitterDays game days either way (hash of the plant id; src/world/growth/phenology.js)
